verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a dedicated test-account environment with a public signup and per-scenario testing guides (payments, test cards, disputes, fraud, payouts, AVS/ANI). For AI-native use, the MCP server has its own Sandbox endpoint separate from the Production one, so agents can be pointed at test infrastructure. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that sandbox data is isolated from production, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A dedicated test-account environment with per-scenario testing docs: payments testing, test cards, disputes testing, fraud-detection testing, bank payouts testing, AVS/ANI check testing
